description: AI-powered SQL query diagnostics across PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server and SQLite. No database connection required.

summary.one_liner: QueryTuner is a web app and REST API that analyzes pasted SQL queries for performance problems across PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server and SQLite, with no database connection required.
summary.what_it_does: QueryTuner takes SQL query text, plus optionally CREATE TABLE DDL, and reports performance issues. A deterministic heuristic engine always runs and flags patterns such as missing indexes, leading wildcards, functions in WHERE clauses, SELECT *, and unbounded ORDER BY, with findings ranked from Critical to Low. An optional AI layer, using Anthropic Claude by default or OpenAI, adds plain-English diagnosis, CREATE INDEX suggestions, and rewrites. Large or multi-statement queries get per-fix before/after suggestions instead of one full rewrite. A separate deterministic annotator adds inline comments without restructuring the query. The README also describes a readability score, basic SQL injection pattern detection, a client-side sanitizer that swaps table and column names for dummy values, shareable report URLs, and a batch page that splits a pasted workload into queries. The REST API is documented at /docs.
use_cases: review a slow SQL query without access to the database
get index suggestions for a query
check SQL in code review or CI pipelines
analyze a batch of queries from a workload
rewrite a query with CTEs and explanations
share a SQL analysis report with a teammate
scrub proprietary table and column names before analysis
how_to_run: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
notable: Dialect-specific index DDL, such as CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY for PostgreSQL and WITH (ONLINE=ON) for SQL Server
Schema-aware mode: pasting CREATE TABLE DDL upgrades index suggestions from estimated to confirmed
Client-side sanitizer keeps proprietary schema names in the browser, with an in-memory substitution map
Heuristic analysis works offline with no API key; AI output is optional
Deterministic annotated query pass that never restructures SQL
caveats: No live database connection; analysis works only from pasted text
AI insights depend on Anthropic or OpenAI APIs being reachable and on an API key
LATERAL join correlated-column detection is not yet supported, per the README
Live DB connection mode and the GitHub Action are listed as planned, not built
Stripe checkout is disabled by default; the README says Pro is granted on request instead
